88641.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in a quiet test location: nobody else invoices, issues credits or clocks time there this week; on the Dashboard, the Technician Utilization tile on This Week shows no percentage (a grey "-").
  3. You run the whole case on one day, and not on the last evening of the week, so every record you create stays inside This Week.
  4. A test customer with one contact and one asset that uses that contact (for example ZZAUTOTEST Dash Customer 1, contact Dana Test, unit ZZ-101).
  5. Technician 1: a technician at this location, with Time Clock on, whose sign-in you have (you clock time as them in a second browser or a private window).
  6. Technician 1 belongs to a department whose time clock is on (for internal, non work order time).
  7. Work-order time: a work order with one labor line (ZZAUTOTEST Line 1, Technician 1, $100.00 an hour, Estimated Time 2.00, Tech Time 2.00) with exactly 2.00 hours clocked on it. It does not need to be invoiced: this tile counts clocked time only.
  8. Internal time: Technician 1 clocked into the department (not a work order) for exactly 1.00 hour earlier today.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list; pick ZZAUTOTEST Dashboard Quiet (it already exists and charges 0 % shop supplies). Check: Dashboard > Technician Utilization tile > range pill > This Week: it shows no percentage (a grey "-"). If it does not, try another location in the list. Locations cannot be deleted, so do not create another one: if no location is quiet this week, mark the case Blocked and write in the result comment that no quiet location was free this week.
  • For 4: Customers > New Customer > Name > Save; on its Contacts tab: New Contact; add an asset (Add beside Asset in the New Work Order window, or the customer's Assets tab) and pick that contact in the asset's Contact field.
  • For 5: Technician 1: a technician offered in Add Technician at this location whose sign-in you have. If there is none, create one: profile icon > Settings > Staff > New Staff Member: a name (for example ZZAUTOTEST Technician1), an Email you can open, Role Technician, a Department, Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close; accept the invitation email and set a password.
  • For 6: profile icon > Settings > Departments lists departments with Clock Time Enabled (for example Training; New Department > Name, Enable time clock? on > Save & Close). A technician gets a department when created (New Staff Member > Departments).
  • For 7: create a work order: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and an Asset (Add beside either if needed) > Save (if a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create); set Service Advisor to Advisor A in the left panel; in the New Line window (> New Line on the Lines tab for each further line): What Are You Doing? ZZAUTOTEST Line 1, Add Technician Technician 1, Labor Rate EVR Travel to EVO ($100 an hour), Estimated Time 2 and Tech Time 2, tick Line Approved > Save & Close; as Technician 1 in a second browser: open the work order > on the line's Labor row click Start, then Stop > Clock Out; as Admin make the clocked time exactly 2.00 hours: three dots at the top right of the Lines tab > Timesheets (1) > edit the record (if it cannot be edited there or in Reports > Timesheet Activities, keep the real time and use the hours Timesheet Activities shows in every sum).
  • For 8: as Technician 1 in the second browser: Clock In in the top bar > choose the department > clock out; as Admin: Reports > Timesheet Activities > edit that record to exactly 1.00 hour earlier today (if it cannot be edited, use the hours shown there in the sums).
